Fetched fresh this run through the JSON API only — never the wowmeta.com HTML, which is a stale S3 prerender, and never r.jina.ai. Two plain curl calls, both HTTP 200: data.wowmeta.com/manifest.json (snapshotDate 2026-09-15) and data.wowmeta.com/rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json (162,109 B, 44 blocks). The manifest step and the rankings step run independently, so the rankings file was fetched and diffed rather than short-circuited on an unchanged snapshotDate. Selected the 3 blocks with categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} AND sortField === "lowerBound" AND keyRange === undefined — a WHITELIST, because melee and ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would silently double-count 27 specs — giving 27 + 7 + 6 = 40 rows, 0 unmatched (classSpec.className/.spec are byte-identical to the roster), 0 duplicates. Merged lowerBound at the series' stored 1-dp precision (read off data/specs.json before merging, not assumed) as "M+ lower-bound 95% CI rating (Blizzard API, population-wide)", n = numberOfCharacters, asOf = manifest.snapshotDate — the SOURCE's date, never the run date. Pre-merge diff: 0 of 40 values, 0 of 40 n and 0 of 40 dates moved against the committed state. Its published LETTERS were not ingested and must not be; lowerBound is a sample-size-penalised population MEAN, deliberately distinct from Murlok's top-50 ceiling. success rather than partial because the source's own snapshotDate is 2026-09-15, one day old and inside the 1-day rule; the stored date is confirmed, not advanced.
